title: Languages of Africa - Wikipedia
text: The Niger–Kordofanian language family, joining Niger–Congo with the Kordofanian languages of south-central Sudan, was proposed in the 1950s by Joseph Greenberg. Today, linguists often use "Niger–Congo" to refer to this entire family, including Kordofanian as a subfamily.

title: Paleni language
text: Paleni is a minor Gur language within the Niger–Congo family, spoken exclusively by the Paleni ethnic community in the village of Faniagara, located in the Cascades Region of southwestern Burkina Faso.
